Question 11
?

The region enclosed by the curve y=ln⁡x, the vertical line x=e, and the horizontal line y=0 is rotated 2π radians about the line x=e, as shown in the picture. Which of the following integrals gives the volume of the resulting solid?

a
π∫01(e2y+2ey+e2)dy
b
π∫01(e2y−2ey+e2)dy
c
π∫01(ey−e)dy
d
π∫01(e2y+2ey+1+e2)dy
e
π∫01(e2y−2ey+1+e2)dy
Submit
